gloss: various places; here and there; several places

definitions.gloss: various places; here and there; several places
definitions.explanation: A formal, written-sounding word meaning "various places" or "here and there." Used in written reports, formal announcements, and literary prose to refer to multiple locations without specifying them. Adverbial use with {に} ("in various places") or {から} ("from various places") is common.

examples.japanese: {諸所|しょしょ}に{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: There are problems in various places.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{建物|たてもの}の{諸所|しょしょ}にひび{割|わ}れが{生|しょう}じた。
examples.english: The earthquake caused cracks in various parts of the building.

examples.japanese: この{資料|しりょう}は{諸所|しょしょ}に{誤|あやま}りがあるため、{全面的|ぜんめんてき}に{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Since there are errors in various places in this document, it needs to be fully reviewed.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{寺院|じいん}の{柱|はしら}や{壁|かべ}の{諸所|しょしょ}に、{修復|しゅうふく}の{跡|あと}がはっきりと{残|のこ}っているのが{見|み}て{取|と}れる。
examples.english: You can clearly see the traces of restoration work remaining on various parts of the pillars and walls of the old temple.

notes:
Composed of {諸|しょ} (various, several) and {所|しょ} (place). A formal word belonging to written and careful spoken Japanese.

USAGE:
{諸所|しょしょ} is used mainly in writing — news reports, formal documents, literary prose — to refer to "several places" without naming them. In casual conversation, speakers are much more likely to say あちこち or いろいろなところ.

It is often paired with another word in the compound {諸所|しょしょ}{方々|ほうぼう} ("all over the place, here and there"), a set phrase that emphasizes a wide and scattered distribution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸所|しょしょ}に: in various places
- {諸所|しょしょ}から: from various places
- {諸所|しょしょ}{方々|ほうぼう}: all over the place; here, there, and everywhere
- {諸所|しょしょ}に{問題|もんだい}がある: to have problems in various places
- {諸所|しょしょ}に{見|み}られる: to be seen in various places

SIMILAR WORDS:
- あちこち: here and there — everyday, conversational
- あちらこちら: here and there — slightly more formal than あちこち, still conversational
- いろいろなところ: various places — neutral
- {各所|かくしょ}: each place, various places — similar meaning, also formal; often used for specific known locations (venues, branches)
- {方々|ほうぼう}: everywhere, many places — somewhat old-fashioned on its own

REGISTER:
Written, formal. Avoid in casual conversation; use あちこち instead.
